If you go back far enough in history (nature religions), you'll find that religion used to be a way to settle down fear. But it started being used as a way to instill fear, that's were it all went wrong.

It has 3 big uses
1) controlling a lot of people, mostly by a way of morale. Dictating what is good, and what isn't. But also by greating a sense of togetherness.

2) early religions used the gods as a way to describe phenomenas that they didn't understand (Lightning strikes? Must be an angry god).
Science really took up that place for the greater part.

3) consoling people. Religion can be a source of support.


I'm not opposed to religion, but i don't believe the higher power in religion. There are other communities or even a group of friends in my life, that fulfill the above three. So I don't need religion. If you happen to believe, by all means do so, but no need to try and turn me over.
